node.title: Re^2: Overriding built-in function works only via import()?
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
Consequently it shouldn't work if the import() is called in the same package, right? (Untested)

Hence the perldocs should be clearer:

> [HTTP://perldoc.perl.org/perlsub.html#Overriding-Built-in-Functions|perlsub#Overriding-Built-in-Functions] Overriding may be done only by importing the name from a module at compile time--ordinary predeclaration isn't good enough. 

A module is a .pm which supports importing with [DOC://use|use] It's normal practice to have its own package, but not necessarily so.

Cheers Rolf
